coverage.summary: Applies to rental housing in Cambridge (viewing or renting an apartment and the terms and conditions of tenancy). Two-family dwellings where the owner lives there are exempt.
coverage.owner_conditions: Exemption for 2-family dwellings when the owner lives there.

result.notes: I removed the reference to G.L. c. 151B, § 4(10) from the summary because none of the provided documents contain it. requires_unknown_facts is set to false: the ordinance covers ordinary rental housing, and the only exemption, owner-occupied 2-family dwellings, is listed in unverifiable_exemptions because an address lookup cannot confirm owner occupancy. owner_occupied_exemption_max_units=2 reflects the 2-family exemption. However, the source mentions only 2-family dwellings and does not say whether owner-occupied single-family rentals are exempt. The source is a secondary description on the Human Rights Commission page, not the ordinance text, so the full scope of the exemption is unconfirmed.
